description: This file contains unit tests for the command-line interface (CLI) configuration completer components, including testing WordCompleter and NestedCompleter functionalities from openbb_cli.config.completer module.

classes.name: WordCompleter
classes.description: A completer class that provides word-based completions, supporting features like case-insensitivity.

classes.name: NestedCompleter
classes.description: A completer class that supports nested command structures for CLI prompts.

methods.name: word_completer()
methods.description: Fixture that returns a simple WordCompleter with a predefined list of words.

methods.name: test_word_completer_simple(word_completer)
methods.description: Tests that the WordCompleter correctly completes a prefix 'ex' with case insensitivity.

methods.name: test_word_completer_case_insensitive(word_completer)
methods.description: Tests that the WordCompleter matches 'Ex' to 'example' regardless of case.

methods.name: test_word_completer_no_match(word_completer)
methods.description: Ensures that the WordCompleter returns no completions for a text with no matches.

methods.name: nested_completer()
methods.description: Fixture that returns a NestedCompleter instance with a nested command structure.

methods.name: test_nested_completer_root_command(nested_completer)
methods.description: Tests that the NestedCompleter suggests 'show' when typing 'sh'.

methods.name: test_nested_completer_sub_command(nested_completer)
methods.description: Tests that the NestedCompleter suggests sub-commands like 'version' and 'interfaces' after 'show '.

methods.name: test_nested_completer_no_match(nested_completer)
methods.description: Tests that no completions are returned when input does not match any commands.
